overview.description: This fund seeks to track the investment results of the ICE BulletShares® Municipal Bond 2036 Index. It generally invests in U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade municipal bonds issued by U.S. states and local governments that are scheduled to mature in 2036. The fund has a designated year of maturity and is intended to terminate on or about December 15, 2036.
